# Houssem Gabsi

> A studio of one that builds websites, booking systems, automations and content systems for businesses of any kind, from independent professionals to established firms.

Based in Tunis. Works in English, French and Arabic.

Site: https://houssem-gabsi.vercel.app/

## Services

- Websites and applications: Websites, online shops, booking systems, dashboards and internal tools, designed and built end to end.
- Operations that run without manual effort: The repeated work, handled inside the tools you already use. A member of your team approves anything before it is sent.
- Brand identity and content systems: A recognisable identity, and a content process that turns one idea into a month of publishing, structured for search engines and AI assistants.

## Cases

Four pieces of client work. Clients are not named.

### A recruiting website that keeps itself current

Executive search firm, Washington D.C., since 2025

An eighteen-page website with open roles synchronised from the firm's recruiting system. A tool that formats candidate CVs to the firm's standard. An interactive map of its consultant network. The firm's recruiting database and internal chat connected to its AI assistant, so the team can query its own candidate data.

Status: Website live. Candidate scoring in development: each candidate assessed against the criteria of the search, with written reasoning for every score.

### A guesthouse website and identity, drawn from the house itself

Maison d'hôte, La Marsa, 2026

A visual identity drawn from the house itself: its tiles, doors and objects. A bilingual website in French and English designed around that identity, and the printed material guests handle, including room cards and the table d'hôte menu.

Status: Identity, print and website delivered.

### Class booking on a single screen

Yoga studio, Tunis, 2026

A mobile-first booking application. Class schedule, availability and payment on a single screen, in French and English.

Status: Live.

### An AI assistant built around an editorial week

Journalist, video production, 2026

His AI assistant configured around his editorial work rather than the software's defaults. Recurring weekly tasks now follow a consistent, repeatable process, with video production at the centre.

Status: Delivered.

## Systems

- Invoice and quote follow-up: Reviews the inbox, quotes and invoices, identifies unanswered enquiries, stalled quotes and overdue invoices, and drafts a reply for each. Nothing is sent without approval. Status: Built and working. Shown here with sample data.
- Content system: Turns one idea into a researched article and a week of posts. Every figure is verified against a named source before publication, and each piece is structured to be cited by search engines and AI assistants. Status: In weekly use on client work.
- Candidate scoring in your recruiting database: Assesses every candidate on a search against that search's criteria, and records the score and the reasoning in the candidate's record. The decision stays with a person. Status: In development for an executive search firm.
- Interview notes to client report: Converts raw notes into a finished report in your own format. Every rating references the source notes, and gaps are flagged rather than filled. Status: Built and working. Shown here with sample data.

## How an engagement starts

1. Initial review: A free one-page review of where the business is losing time. No call required.
2. Audit: A paid assessment, with the first three improvements ranked. The fee is credited toward the build.
3. Build: One fixed price, agreed in writing before work begins.
